summary: Lookout tower moved from Apple Orchard Mountain to Purgatory Mountain, Botetourt County, in 1957-1958; the Association lists it as gone.

facts.status_note: Moved here from Apple Orchard Mountain in 1957-1958; the Association lists it as gone, and no source read describes what remains.

events.note: Lookout William Dawson on duty at the Apple Orchard Mountain tower, before the move (August 1933 newspaper item)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1957-1958 for the move and the willhiteweb page gives 1955-1958; the register's narrower range falls inside the wider one, so the story uses the register dates and gives both.

notes_for_editor: The Gone status rests on the Association list alone. No Purgatory Mountain register page exists in the cache (a guessed URL returned 404 during the Apple Orchard research), so whether any of the moved frame still stands there is unverified. The 60-foot and 14 x 14 ft cab figures come from one personal-site page with 'said to be' wording, so they are not in facts.height_m (that field is cab-floor height). The 1933 staffing event is at the Apple Orchard tower before the move; drop it if the editor wants only Purgatory-era events. Access is not established; the Apple Orchard story's Wikipedia open-summit claim is about the summit, not Purgatory. The Apple Orchard record correction (gone to moved) is separate and is not repeated here.
